I recently travelled from Dehradun to Delhi with my friend and had a booking at FabHotel Twamev. During check-in, my friend (18 years old) was allowed, but I was denied entry as I am 17 years old.
While I understand that hotels may have internal policies regarding age, what was completely unacceptable was the extremely harsh, rude, and disrespectful behaviour of the staff. There was zero sense of professionalism and absolutely no polite communication. We tried to talk calmly and understand the situation, but the staff spoke arrogantly and made no effort to explain things respectfully.
For clarity:
There is NO LAW in India that says a 17-year-old boy cannot travel or stay at a hotel. Minors are legally allowed to travel freely within the country. This is purely a hotel policy, not a legal restriction — something the staff failed to explain properly and instead chose to behave rudely.
Hospitality is not just about rules, it’s about how you treat guests. Even if denying check-in, basic courtesy and respect are expected, which was completely missing here.
Very disappointing experience. I would not recommend this hotel, especially if you expect decent behaviour and professional staff.

(At last no refund was done and was thrown out...)
